about: Basketball's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L1): a sport's standard scoring, categories, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are Basketball's (src/lib/sports/basketball.ts); slots take its positions or position groups (a box score says G, F or C, a roster PG, SG, SF, PF or C, so a guard's slot takes G too). The specs are in the game spec's shape (A1's schema, on the engine branch); slots and categories aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.

categories.source: Yahoo's standard 9 categories (rotisserie and head-to-head categories)

season.about: A season-long league: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head each week.

short.about: One game, a series or a team's next few: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores, most points wins.
